llm.summary: The skill's behavior (uploads local audio to Crazyrouter with a required API key) matches its stated purpose, but the registry metadata fails to declare the required CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY and the runtime uses npx to pull remote code — these inconsistencies and supply-chain/credential concerns warrant caution.

dimensions.detail: The skill's code and SKILL.md clearly require a CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY (and optionally CRAZYROUTER_BASE_URL) to call Crazyrouter’s /audio/transcriptions or /audio/translations endpoints — this is coherent with a speech-to-text purpose. However, the registry metadata lists no required environment variables or primary credential, which is an incoherence: the skill will fail without an API key and the missing metadata hides that credential requirement.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are narrowly scoped to uploading a user-provided audio file to Crazyrouter/Whisper and returning the transcript. The SKILL.md explicitly checks for CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY and instructs how to run the bundled script. The instructions do send user audio to an external API (expected for STT) but do not attempt to read other system files or unrelated env vars.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No formal install spec is provided (instruction-only plus a script file). The usage examples invoke 'npx -y tsx' which will fetch and execute the 'tsx' package from npm at runtime — this is a normal way to run TypeScript but does pull remote code on demand (supply-chain/trust consideration). No downloads from obscure URLs or archives are present in the package itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY (and supports CRAZYROUTER_BASE_URL), but the registry metadata does not declare any required environment variables or a primary credential. That mismatch is problematic because the skill needs a secret to operate and the metadata does not surface that to users. No other unrelated credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent presence (always is false), does not modify other skills or system-wide configs, and does not demand elevated privileges. Autonomous invocation is permitted by default but not combined with other privilege escalation indicators.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing: be aware this skill uploads audio to Crazyrouter and requires a CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY (the registry metadata currently does NOT advertise this). Confirm you trust Crazyrouter’s service and privacy policy because your audio will be sent to a third party. Note the usage examples run 'npx -y tsx', which fetches and executes a package from npm at runtime — consider the supply-chain risk. Ask the publisher to correct the metadata to list CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY (and CRAZYROUTER_BASE_URL if applicable). Avoid transcribing highly sensitive audio unless you accept that it will leave your machine, and consider using an ephemeral or limited-permission API key if possible.
